description: One queued connector bridge record (state/connector-bridge/<id>.json), written by server/connector.py for a bridged tool call and fulfilled home-side. Envelope idempotency: a second enqueue with the same (caller, envelope_id) returns the existing record with deduped: true instead of queueing a twin. Fulfillment sets status done|failed with fulfilled_by, fulfilled_at, and result or error.
title: Connector bridge record
